name: bile_gout
for: road bloater belch (Motion::Strike, reach 0.2-2.4 m, band 0.4-1.9 m; side.rs BLOATER and fight.rs BLOATER belch)
notes: A thick, lumpy rope of yellow-green bile (lit top, dark olive underside, sprite's own lime for highlights) spewed from the mouth with a spurt of droplets, arcing 2.4 m forward and down to the floor (lands ~133 px ahead, 77 px below the anchor = mouth height ~1.4 m), dark chunks and droplets flung along it, drips falling from its underside; the tail detaches and drains into the landing point. Anchor = the mouth. Play bile_splash (anchor feet) at the landing point from frame 5.
